verbs.name: ui.state
verbs.description: Revisioned, path-safe state from the connected UI: active workspace and left/right/review tabs, overlays/dialogs, available and agent-openable surface ids, playhead, selection, export range, safe project identity, and the currently rendered About version when its visible text has committed. Errors no_ui_client after the last UI socket disconnects.

verbs.name: ui.screenshot
verbs.description: Ask the connected UI client to capture itself. returns {path, mime}; inline:true adds base64. Errors no_ui_client when no UI is connected; partial fallback = render.frame composite + DOM-state JSON marked partial.
verbs.result: {path, mime, base64?, notes?} — notes? rides along when panels were composited from live pixels
